query: 各部门本月工时对比
generated_sql:
SELECT 
  org_dept.dept_name AS 部门名称,
  SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(workhour.workhour_date) = DATE(NOW()) THEN workhour.workhour ELSE 0 END) AS 今日工时,
  SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(workhour.workhour_date) = DATE(NOW() - INTERVAL 1 DAY) THEN workhour.workhour ELSE 0 END) AS 昨日工时,
  SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(workhour.workhour_date) = DATE(NOW() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) THEN workhour.workhour ELSE 0 END) AS 本周工时,
  SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(workhour.workhour_date) BETWEEN DATE(NOW() - INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND DATE(NOW()) THEN workhour.workhour ELSE 0 END) AS 本月工时
FROM 
  workhour
JOIN 
  sys_user ON workhour.member_id = sys_user.id
JOIN 
  org_dept ON sys_user.dept_id = org_dept.id
WHERE 
  workhour.is_deleted = 0
GROUP BY 
  org_dept.dept_name
ORDER BY 
  org_dept.dept_name
LIMIT 10;
